facts.intro_first_150_words: The growing demand for AI is obvious The real question is What’s the build plan For data center operators meeting AI demand comes down to turning opportunity into operational capacity Is there a credible path to power Is electrical and mechanical capacity committed Can the project schedule survive a site change or a labor shortage If those answers are vague the forecast doesn’t matter even if demand is expected to triple by 2030 Leading operators make those decisions before they win the deal They build an execution plan early so when demand materializes they’re ready to turn it into revenue-producing capacity AI infrastructure deployment Demand is easy Execution is hard Scale is relative I see customers building 50 MW a year and others building ten or twenty times that Both can operate at scale The number changes but the discipline doesn’t At scale the second third and fifth projects don’t
